elements.requirement: A company qualifies as small in relation to its first financial year if the qualifying conditions are met in that year.
elements.quote: A company qualifies as small in relation to its first financial year if the qualifying conditions are met in that year.

elements.requirement: Subject to the two consecutive financial years rule in subsection (2), a company qualifies as small in relation to a subsequent financial year if the qualifying conditions are met in that year.
elements.quote: Subject to subsection (2), a company qualifies as small in relation to a subsequent financial year if the qualifying conditions are met in that year.

elements.requirement: In relation to a subsequent financial year, where on its balance sheet date a company meets or ceases to meet the qualifying conditions, that change affects its qualification as a small company only if it occurs in two consecutive financial years.
elements.quote: that affects its qualification as a small company only if it occurs in two consecutive financial years.

elements.requirement: A company meets the qualifying conditions in a financial year in which it satisfies two or more of the requirements relating to turnover, balance sheet total, and number of employees.
elements.quote: The qualifying conditions are met by a company in a year in which it satisfies two or more of the following requirements

elements.requirement: The turnover requirement is met by a company if its turnover is not more than £10.2 million.
elements.quote: Turnover Not more than £10.2 million

elements.requirement: The balance sheet total requirement is met by a company if its balance sheet total is not more than £5.1 million.
elements.quote: Balance sheet total Not more than £5.1 million

elements.requirement: The employee count requirement is met by a company if its number of employees is not more than 50.
elements.quote: Number of employees Not more than 50

elements.requirement: For a period that is a company's financial year but not in fact a year, the maximum figures for turnover must be proportionately adjusted.
elements.quote: For a period that is a company's financial year but not in fact a year the maximum figures for turnover must be proportionately adjusted.

elements.requirement: A company's balance sheet total means the aggregate of the amounts shown as assets in the company's balance sheet.
elements.quote: The balance sheet total means the aggregate of the amounts shown as assets in the company's balance sheet.

elements.requirement: A company's number of employees means the average number of persons employed by the company in the year, calculated by finding the number of persons employed under contracts of service in each month (whether throughout the month or not), adding together the monthly totals, and dividing by the number of months in the financial year.
elements.quote: The number of employees means the average number of persons employed by the company in the year, determined as follows— (a) find for each month in the financial year the number of persons employed under contracts of service by the company in that month (whether throughout the month or not), (b) add together the monthly totals, and (c) divide by the number of months in the financial year.

elements.requirement: Section 382 of the Companies Act 2006 is subject to section 383 regarding parent companies qualifying as small.
elements.quote: This section is subject to section 383 (companies qualifying as small: parent companies).
